replicate_statements: Mean±s.d. of three independent experiments is reported.
outputs.explanation: The quantified cell-death bar graph in panel A is explicitly reported as mean±s.d. of three independent experiments (n=3), satisfying both n-number and replicate type. The accompanying western blots are representative (unquantified) images and do not require replicate reporting.

Panel B shows a quantified bar graph of cell death with visible error bars, indicating replicated measurements, but the legend text for panel B (unlike A and C) contains no statement of the number of experiments/replicates or their type.

replicate_statements: Mean±s.d. of three experiments is reported.
outputs.explanation: The cell-death time-course bar graph in panel C is reported as mean±s.d. of three experiments, providing both the n-number (3) and a replicate type descriptor.

Panel D presents a quantified cell-death bar graph with error bars, but the legend gives no indication of how many replicates/experiments were performed or what type of replicate (biological, technical, etc.) underlies the error bars.
